artifact_layout: one summary per (panel x construction): data/research/top_anatomy_p1_<panel>_<construction>_summary.json — six files for the six runs
vintage_note: prereg §2 pins the phase-0/W2 tape vintage (2026-07-02); --allow-stale is how that choice is declared post-#5319, and no phase-1 claim is about today's market
engine_frozen: engine/top_anatomy.py is byte-frozen at main for this wave; every phase-1 move lives in this harness
moved_variable: control observation SELECTION and STRATIFICATION only (prereg §1); episodes, races, peaks, features, the {21,10,5} case snapshots, the episode-first collapse and the episode-peak-month block bootstrap are unchanged
tier: research/display tier, zero scored authority; AVOID-not-SHORT; no rank, no size, no gate, no exit rule

panel_meta.panel_cache_sharing_basis: panel content is upstream of every EXT mask AND of every control construction; the identity stamp refuses anything downstream of either

prefix_parity_gate.note: the §3 repair gate is a PANEL property; it is upstream of both the EXT mask and the control construction, so this receipt is about the repair

episode_census.definition: DISJOINT = the episode's arm EXT-day set shares ZERO (segment, session) days with the phase-0 primary set — the W2 classification, reused, never re-derived

era_blocks.rule: the panel's topped-episode peak-months in 3 CONTIGUOUS calendar blocks of as-equal-as-possible month counts; computed from the PANEL, so AM and DM report the same cells

cases.case_anchor: the FROZEN phase-0 §4.5 snapshots at days_to_peak in [21, 10, 5] — phase-1 moves the CONTROL side only, so the case anchor is untouched

feature_panel.sharing_basis: a control CONSTRUCTION selects and stratifies control observations; it does not enter any feature value, so the feature panel's identity is the EXT variant and rebuilding it per construction would recompute identical numbers

control_construction.frozen_pool_definition: phase-0 §4.5: every CONTINUED-labelled EXT day on the panel is a control candidate
control_construction.restriction: DM: no day-level restriction — the construction moves the MATCHING KEY (episode-age tercile), not the candidate day set
control_construction.sampling: episode-first: ONE qualifying day per continued episode, drawn with the frozen seed BEFORE matching

dm_age_stratum.definition: episode age at the anchor day; tercile edges cut on the pooled case-anchor + control-candidate set

matching.matcher: harness p1_matched_controls — the frozen W4 key on the engine's own bucketer, plus the declared stratum
matching.bin_edges: quintile/tercile edges cut WITHIN CALENDAR QUARTER over this panel's own case+candidate union (prereg §2: bins are population-relative)

diagnostic.role: DM stratification variable — episode age, coarsely matched
diagnostic.collapse_rule: mechanical reading declared in the plumbing commit: |phase-1 delta| < |phase-0/W2 anchor delta| on the same panel. Printed as a reading, never as a grade — the G0.5 adjudicator owns the artifact-vs-anatomy call

registered_cells.family: BH-FDR q <= 0.10 within this (panel x construction) family of exactly 3
registered_cells.one_sided_derivation: One-sided p in the DECLARED direction, read off the same block-bootstrap draws.
registered_cells.grades: P1-SUPPORTED / P1-NOT-SUPPORTED / P1-UNDERPOWERED per prereg §3; P1-SUPPORTED-ERA-CAVEAT when the latest era block is wrong-signed

table.match_rate_definition: matched topped episodes / topped E1-eligible episodes on this panel, after the construction's control restriction
matched topped episodes / topped E1-eligible episodes on this panel, after the construction's control restriction
matched topped episodes / topped E1-eligible episodes on this panel, after the construction's control restriction

b2_era_fade_fence.check: phase-0 fence: a magnitude that shrinks monotonically era over era is the signature the fence exists to surface; printed either way and never a grade

b2_anchor_comparison.reading: registered READING, never a grade (prereg §3): inside -> duration/anchor artifacts do not explain W2's confirmation; below-but-supported -> a partial artifact share, quantified as the same-design point-estimate ratio

exploratory.bh_family: letter family, over the features NOT registered in this construction; the registered three are printed here but graded in the one-sided confirmatory family of 3
exploratory.read_the_full_table_not_this_list: the `separating` list is sign-gated; every phase-1 read comes off `table`, which carries all 36 features whatever their sign

sensitivities.name: dm_day_weighted_sampling
sensitivities.why: §5: DM with the W2-style DAY-WEIGHTED candidate sampling, printed for continuity so the sampling switch's own contribution is visible

candidate_census.sampling: day-weighted (the frozen W2 geometry), printed as the §5 sensitivity so the sampling switch's own contribution is visible
